assertions.claim: Of 2131 severe headaches peaking within one hour, 6.2% (132) were subarachnoid hemorrhage (10 Canadian EDs).
assertions.cn_span: 一小时内到顶的剧烈头痛，2131 人里有 6.2% 是蛛网膜下腔出血

assertions.claim: Any of the six Ottawa SAH-rule criteria (age ≥40, neck pain/stiffness, witnessed syncope, exertional onset, thunderclap, limited neck flexion) → head CT.
assertions.cn_span: 40 岁以上、脖子痛或发硬、有人看到你晕过去、活动中起病、瞬间炸开、脖子前屈受限，中任何一条就去急诊做头颅 CT

assertions.claim: Specificity 15.3% means most people sent by the rule turn out fine, but one missed re-bleed is death — the check is worth it.
assertions.cn_span: 特异性只有 15.3%，意味着按这条去查的人绝大多数查完没事

assertions.claim: Don't take a painkiller and go back to sleep; the key is how fast the pain peaked, not how much it hurts.
assertions.cn_span: 不要吃片止痛药压下去接着睡
